item.title: Morgan Stanley, Schroders Join Record Funding for Canva’s Backer
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: Morgan Stanley and Schroders Plc took part in a A$1.05 billion ($750 million) fundraising by Canva Inc. backer Blackbird Ventures, closing the largest financing for an Australian venture capital firm. The VC firm, one of the first investors in some of its home country’s most highly valued tech startups including Canva and Airwallex, said in a statement Tuesday that its latest fund marks the region’s largest-ever venture capital raise.
